Proxy with username and password credentials authenticates successfully

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	pkg "github.com/xberg-io/crawlberg/packages/go"
)

func main() {
	var engineConfig pkg.CrawlConfig
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"proxy":{"password":"proxypass","url":"http://127.0.0.1:8889","username":"proxyuser"},"respect_robots_txt":false}`), &engineConfig); err != nil {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("config parse failed: %v", err))
	}
	engine, createErr := pkg.CreateEngine(&engineConfig)
	if createErr != nil {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("create handle failed: %v", createErr))
	}
	url := `https://example.com`
	result, err := pkg.Crawl(engine, url)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result)
}
```
